spec_match.rationale: Requests both modes on HTMLCanvasElement, main-thread OffscreenCanvas, a worker OffscreenCanvas, a transferred placeholder canvas in a worker (parity-worker.js), and a WebGPU context (getConfiguration().toneMapping).

interactive.rationale: The run button builds the five-row matrix from real calls.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the unified-dictionary story the card describes.

edge_cases.rationale: Reports WebGPU as blocked when there is no adapter or getConfiguration is missing. Re-running the transferred row is blocked with an explanation, because placeholders can be transferred only once. ImageBitmap carry-over is documented as unobservable.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus, the WebGPU GPUCanvasToneMapping section and the explainer's ImageBitmap section.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 headless (Playwright), default and with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: every button, select and range exercised, console/pageerror/failed-request clean, 0px overflow. All four 2D surfaces echoed 'standard' for 'extended' (IGNORED). WebGPU was blocked (requestAdapter null in headless).

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts parity consistency (all 2D surfaces agree), with honoured/total counts in details.

design_system.rationale: Variables only. Placeholder canvases have role=img names.

accessibility.rationale: A semantic table with row headers, a status summary and a labelled button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: The table scrolls inside its region at 360px. 0px page overflow.

openQuestions.title: Verify the extended success path and the HDR visual on a build with CanvasToneMapping
openQuestions.detail: Chrome 153, the only build available here, reports toneMapping.mode 'standard' even with --enable-blink-features=CanvasToneMapping, so the honoured branch has not run. Re-verify on Chrome 160+/Canary with the flag, ideally on an HDR display: confirm the echo reads 'extended' and that the bottom ramp, sun and highlights exceed SDR white.

openQuestions.title: Verify the WebGPU row on a GPU-backed browser
openQuestions.detail: Headless had no adapter. On a desktop with WebGPU, confirm that getConfiguration().toneMapping.mode echoes both modes.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Controls should be at least 44x44 CSS px on touch screens, and components should adapt to their container so nothing overflows.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons, selects, inputs and ranges have min-height 44px. Selects inside .field are width:100% after a measured 117px overflow at 360px caused by long option text. Every page was re-measured at 0px overflow at 360x740 and 1280x800.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: drive.js runs: overflow=0 on every page/viewport; responsive-check desktop ok 1/1, mobile ok 1/1

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native controls with labels. Announce discrete outcomes through polite status/log regions and keep rapidly changing values out of live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every control is a native button/select/input with a visible label. Outcomes go to role=status / role=log regions. High-frequency readouts (slider positions, meters) use aria-live=off and announce only on change of state.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive grid of readouts collapsing to one column
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use grid with min-width:0 children and let tracks collapse on narrow containers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Fact/readout grids are one column below 640px and min-width:0 on grid children. A measured 91px overflow from <pre> blocks in a 2-column grid was fixed with .cmp > div { min-width: 0 }.

summary: An advanced cross-surface check that one CanvasToneMapping dictionary behaves the same on 2D, Offscreen, worker and WebGPU contexts.
